overall_notes: The paper focuses on creating a multilingual legal summarization dataset (MILDSum) and benchmarking various summarization approaches. It evaluates both extractive and abstractive models using automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore) but does not conduct human evaluation or use LLMs as judges. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and metric variants.
